name: duopore-public-invoice-draft
description: Make an invoice draft from your items, prices and tax rates, with the totals worked out.

interface.longDescription: Make an invoice draft from your items, prices and tax rates, with the totals worked out. Enter your business details, dates and line items. Check the draft before you use it. The app shows the maths and offers PDF and Excel files in a supported host or on the website. Use EUR, USD or GBP, with up to 25 line items. The app uses your tax rates. It does not send invoices or take payments.
capabilities: Check line totals and supplied tax
defaultPrompt: Make an invoice draft from these items and prices.
Show the tax and total for this invoice draft.
